title: stc project (edit document), v9
description: Everything the user can change after recording. render(project, session, t) is a pure function of this document plus the session data. v9 adds `systemAudioLevel`: how loud the recorded system audio (anchors-6's system.m4a, STC-418) plays in preview and export, 0..1 — attenuate only, never boost, so it cannot clip; 0 mutes the track while the recording itself is kept. Absent means 1 (full level), and a document at full level stays at whatever version its other edits earned. v8 adds `bookmarks`: marked frames as session-relative integer ns, for the editor's Up/Down navigation (STC-444 slice 4) — ns rather than an export-frame index, so a bookmark still means the same instant if a later build's export fps ever changes. Sorted ascending, no duplicates; absent means none and parseProject fills []. v7 adds `slug`: the stable name this take publishes under (STC-444 slice 3) — absent means not yet decided, and share.ts's autoSlug(takeName) supplies a live default the editor shows without writing it here; only set on a successful share. Not validated against share.ts's SLUG_PATTERN in this schema (a stored slug that fails it is still a v8 document; planPublish is where an unusable one is refused). v6 adds `overrides`: manual zoom overrides — a discriminated union. The 'geometry' variant (STC-330) tunes a DERIVED window, keyed by its startNs (as a string). The 'manual' variant (STC-331) authors a window with no auto-zoom counterpart at all, carrying its own startNs/endNs and a REQUIRED easing, since there is no derived window or project default timing to fall back to. The 'removed' and 'retime' variants (STC-329) act on a DERIVED window without touching its crop: 'removed' drops it outright; 'retime' shifts its startNs and/or endNs (either optional, for a one-edge drag) while keeping the SAME windowId — the window's original derived startNs, unaffected by the retime. Every variant with a rect uses UV over the CAPTURE, the same space a redaction lives in. Absent on every document written before project-6; parseProject fills [].

overrideRect.description: UV over the CAPTURE (0..1), not the output — the same space a redaction lives in.

fps.description: export samples every other 120 Hz sim tick; only 60 supported in phase 1

style.description: default is the macOS pointer set (STC-239); circle is the phase-1 placeholder, kept as an option

pip.description: Fixed-corner picture-in-picture. Absent means no PiP.

widthPct.description: fraction of output width; 0.125 gives 480px on a 3840px canvas

trim.description: Non-destructive in/out. Absent means the full take. Session-relative integer ns; endNs must be greater than startNs.

transform.description: Which transform renders this edit. TRANSFORM_HISTORY in transform/src/transform-version.ts says what each number drew; a change to any constant that reaches the pixels bumps it.

zoom.description: Auto-zoom settings (STC-325). Absent on every document written before project-4; parseProject fills the default.

intensity.description: Scales the eased amount. 1 is the preset's full travel; 0 is indistinguishable from off.

preset.description: Must equal ZOOM_PRESET_NAMES in transform/src/zoom.ts — a test holds the two together.

textPt.description: The recorded application’s base text size in POINTS on the captured display. Points, not pixels: the legibility figure is textPt * embedWidth / display.pointWidth, and backingScale cancels. Absent means DEFAULT_TEXT_PT (13) in transform/src/legibility.ts.

slug.description: The stable name this take publishes under (STC-444 slice 3). Absent means not yet decided. Not pattern-constrained here — see the top-level description for why.

systemAudioLevel.description: The system-audio track's level (STC-418), a linear gain applied after the take, never at capture: system.m4a is always recorded at full level so a bad setting can be undone. 0..1, attenuate only. Absent means 1; meaningless on a take with no system track, and harmless there.

bookmarks.description: Marked frames, as session-relative integer ns (STC-444 slice 4). Absent means none; parseProject fills []. Ordering and uniqueness are the writer's job, not enforced here (array order in JSON Schema is not a set constraint worth a draft-07 workaround) — trim.ts's cleanBookmarks is what actually sorts and de-duplicates on read.

overrides.description: Manual zoom overrides. Absent means none. x+width and y+height must each be <= 1; that sum constraint is not expressible here and is the loader's job (transform/src/trim.ts's cleanOverrides), same as recording.ts's endNs > startNs.

oneOf.description: STC-330: tunes a DERIVED window. windowId matches that window's startNs (transform/src/zoom.ts's ZoomWindow), as a string — stage 1's merge rule guarantees uniqueness within one take.

easing.description: Replaces the project's own zoom.preset for JUST this window. Absent means this window plays at the project's preset.

oneOf.description: STC-331: authors a window with no auto-zoom counterpart at all. Carries its own timing, unlike the geometry variant, and easing is REQUIRED — there is no derived window or project default to fall back to.
STC-329: drops a DERIVED window outright — it never plays, not even at its old crop. windowId matches that window's original startNs, the same key the geometry variant uses.

STC-329: shifts a DERIVED window's startNs and/or endNs, keeping its ORIGINAL startNs as windowId so a geometry override (or a later retime) keyed on it still finds the window. At least one bound is required — an entry naming neither shifts nothing.
